notes.title: Major Demo Update & Kickstarter Live Now!
notes.notes:
Our new, improved, updated demo is now live! And alongside it… our Kickstarter! (check it out here)

Included in this new demo we have:

Investigation mode! Talk to your scapegoats to find new evidence.

2 of 15 total routes in the game. Talk to Alexandra and Grudge to start building a case against them!

The Evidence Notebook, AKA the best place to keep an eye on all the evidence gathered and how you've made everyone else feel along the way…

The Map - choose who to talk to, or who to listen in on.

You can also just, talk to Dave. If you want.

We recommend you start new saves to continue the demo in case of compatibility issues, but liberal use of the skip button located at the bottom of the screen should get you far! We'll be implementing a more comprehensive quick start option for the full game, we promise.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751204/9de796a9e7653365abf172066a45b9d2987278b8.png"]

As for the Kickstarter, we'd love it if you could check out the page, but for a quick summary, here are some rewards available:

New hairstyle customisation options

Help shape the game with early beta access

Become a background character

Get added to the board of shame as a banned customer

Soundtrack and artbook digital download

Share the campaign and its social posts to get a Date with Dave!

Thank you so much for all the love and wishlists the game has received so far, we're very excited to bring the full game to you. In the meantime, we'll keep you updated on our progress!

Lots of love, the Skeletal Games team.

notes.title: Coming Soon: Demo Update & Kickstarter!
notes.notes:
Hey there Steam denizens, it's been a little while! 



We've been busy, working quietly in the background to bring you an updated demo showcasing how investigation works in Spill the Beans. That's right, on 7th July you'll be able to interrogate our scapegoats in two of the fifteen total routes that will be available in the full game - and maybe see where the story takes you on the way! 



And on the note of updates, we'll also be launching our Kickstarter on that day! This game has been a passion project of ours for the last few years, and we hope to use the Kickstarter to let us dedicate proper time to getting the game over the finish line!


Should you back the Kickstarter or help spread awareness, you'll be able to get some fun rewards like new customisation options, an artbook, and even the ability to date one of our NPCs in a special side story (goals willing).


We hope to see you back here on the 7th, for the new demo and Kickstarter! In the meantime, feel free to follow us on our socials.


Lots of love, the Skeletal Games team.
